analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($75.88) vs SMA5 ($79.30)/SMA20 ($83.04)/SMA50 ($89.56): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($89.51)/SMA200 ($83.59): below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (42.8%) + current price level approaching historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.7→37.5) + entering oversold territory, maintaining downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1.2554→-0.1870) + improvement diagnosis, in weak convergence zone.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $71.84) + band width expanded to 26.99%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level ($72.13) + basis (lower BB, 20-day low).
· Swing resistance level ($76.67) + potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $75.58, 20-day low $72.13): no clear Higher Low formed, potential for sideways movement.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.35x) + low conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (oversold entry within downtrend) + possibility of short-term rebound attempt, 72.13 support confirmation needed.
